features: Ultra-Lightweight Wearable Design: Our mini keychain camera weighs less than 1 ounce (about 28g) and can be clipped onto your backpack, keys, or worn as a necklace. Whether you're hanging out with friends, exploring the city, or capturing everyday moments, it's a stylish accessory that lets you document life hands-free.

Retro Filters & Decent Image Quality with Flash: This mini flip screen retro camera supports 1080P video and up to 48MP photos, with 6 built-in vintage filters (retro, black & white, warm tone, etc.) that give your shots a nostalgic Y2K vibe—no editing needed. A built-in flash is also available, so you can shoot confidently even in low-light settings. Perfect for creating aesthetic content with a classic feel, straight out of camera.

180° Flip Screen for Easy Selfies: Equipped with a 1.47-inch HD screen that flips 180°, this mini camera keychain makes selfies and vlogging effortless. Frame your shot perfectly every time. The pre-installed 32GB SD card gives you plenty of space to store memories without worrying about running out of room.

90-Minute Battery Life & USB Transfer: Built-in rechargeable battery supports up to 90 minutes of continuous recording—ideal for a day out with friends. When you're ready to share, simply connect via USB to your computer and transfer files quickly to social media or your favorite editing app.

Creative Gift for Young Creators: Designed for fun, creative photography, this camera is a thoughtful gift for teens, students, or anyone who loves retro style. It’s not a professional DSLR replacement, but it’s a playful, easy-to-use tool that makes photography enjoyable and accessible for beginners and hobbyists alike.
